recipe.ghg_method: Native EDGAR-consistent GHG total only, converted from kilotonnes to tonnes; source characterisation retained. Detailed gas/source rows and the separate OECD-consistent inventory are not added again. Native GWP vintage and residence/territorial bridge are not harmonised with EDGAR 2026.
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP at market prices: basic-price value added plus net product taxes
recipe.gdp_note: GLORIA GDP adds original product taxes and signed subsidies on intermediate and final commodity uses to the six basic-price value-added rows. The world income/expenditure check differs by less than 0.001%. Source vintages may differ from World Bank national accounts.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the explicitly listed value-added rows in the source; product taxes and balancing adjustments are excluded.
recipe.attribution: GLORIA v060, University of Sydney / UNEP International Resource Panel. CC BY-NC 3.0 Australia. Non-commercial MARIO research indicators: six native value-added rows summed; native GHG CO2eq converted from kilotonnes to tonnes, with direct final-demand emissions included once. January 2026 economic tables and April 2024 satellite vintage. No endorsement is implied. GDP adds source-signed product-tax and subsidy valuations on intermediate and final uses.

recipe.value_added_basis: Value added at basic prices; six explicit source factor rows
recipe.ghg_basis: Native EDGAR-consistent GHG total plus direct final-demand emissions; source CO2eq characterisation retained
recipe.gwp_basis: Native CO2eq; IPCC AR5 GWP100 verified for CO2, CH4, N2O, SF6 and NF3; other F-gases unverified
recipe.ghg_note: GLORIA retains its native EDGAR-consistent CO2eq total. Independent checks of the 2001 and 2024 gas rows recover AR5 GWP100 factors for CO2, CH4, N2O, SF6 and NF3. Individual factors for all fluorinated gases remain unverified; the 2024 cell-level gas-row fit has a relative L2 residual of about 0.15%. The EDGAR 2026 territorial boundary also differs.
recipe.scope_note: GLORIA 2025: economic vintage 20260121; satellite vintage 20240417. GDP includes the verified source product-tax valuation bridge.

input_layout.metadata_boundary: The observed ReadMe has different bytes from the frozen workbook. All parser-consumed ordered sets and units were independently verified unchanged, with native VA/GHG/EY row checks. The cause of unrelated workbook differences is undetermined.
input_layout.instructions: Place exactly these three files together in a dedicated source directory. The full source companion requires all three. Selected non-GHG account runners still require the ReadMe but do not require the satellite archive.

metadata.basis_note: Region_names are not consumed by numerical parse; the canonical publication retains frozen original geography. No assertion about unconsumed workbook cells or the cause of binary differences.

review.archive_inventory_boundary: Compared the exact retained member names, uncompressed sizes, compressed sizes and CRC32 values. No prior full-archive SHA256 existed in this original provenance, so this does not claim a historical whole-archive SHA256 match; the restarted collector must fingerprint current archives.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. GLORIA retains its native EDGAR-consistent CO2eq total. Independent checks of the 2001 and 2024 gas rows recover AR5 GWP100 factors for CO2, CH4, N2O, SF6 and NF3. Individual factors for all fluorinated gases remain unverified; the 2024 cell-level gas-row fit has a relative L2 residual of about 0.15%. The EDGAR 2026 territorial boundary also differs.
notes.value_added_trade: Upstream value added embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Domestic and Foreign identify value added generated inside or outside the exporting native region. Total includes both and can closely match gross monetary trade in balanced systems. Repeated border crossings can count the same value added again; this is not value-added exports measured by ultimate foreign final absorption.
notes.ghg_trade: Upstream production GHG embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Repeated border crossings can count the same emissions again. Direct final-user emissions and unrepresented production accounts are not allocated to traded output. GLORIA retains its native EDGAR-consistent CO2eq total. Independent checks of the 2001 and 2024 gas rows recover AR5 GWP100 factors for CO2, CH4, N2O, SF6 and NF3. Individual factors for all fluorinated gases remain unverified; the 2024 cell-level gas-row fit has a relative L2 residual of about 0.15%. The EDGAR 2026 territorial boundary also differs.

sector_scope.qualification: The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists.
